cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule at tonight's club meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Ask him to restore your booking as well. I'll draft both requests for your speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then sign it. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave space for my signature. Once he's agreed you have a point, call me up to add it.

mechanism: A controls the timing of personal endorsement while directing B to challenge the captain first, offering help without taking the initial exposure.
confusable: General coalition building shares risk; D56 specifically withholds A risk until someone else tests the challenge.
comparison: Delayed public signature differs from the overtime scene standing behind the questioner.
seedUse: The existing D56-b conditional signature is a superior-set term for B requested solidarity, sustaining the pair.
